title: Enforce scheduling guards for future review_identity CLI fixture tests
outcome: New or modified review_identity CLI fixture tests cannot silently omit, misorder or prematurely drop the required scheduling guard.
acceptance: A fixture-test wrapper or equivalent automated check rejects fixture work without the required first named scheduling guard, including an immediately dropped `let _ =` guard.
The current exclusive ownership of every review_identity CLI fixture test through cleanup, real CLI execution and unchanged production timeout remain covered.
disposal_reason: Parent scheduling repair w-cc672688ae8e completed after landing cd79424e. Continue the separately tracked Low guard-enforcement follow-up as independent optional P3 work; preserve R1/R2 review provenance and current all-fixtures-exclusive contract.
